notes.title: ✨🐝New Decoration Update! 🐝✨
notes.content:
[h1]Update v.0.2.0 🍯[/h1][p]A new update, v.0.2.0, is out now! This update improves on most aspects of the game while also bringing brand new features.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857148/ec234e24cf40095e5b34f26c6a42ad774937cde9.png"][/img][/p][h2]Decoration 🌳[/h2][p]The big one is the new Decoration feature. You can now decorate the forest with more than just flowers! Place chairs, tables, vases, rocks, pumpkins and much more, wherever you want in the forest.[/p][p]You will start off with a big set of decorations, but some you will have to unlock. And even more are coming in future updates. [/p][p]If you join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/UFa25FSt8z"]Discord[/url] you will be able to suggest decorations that might end up in the game! ✨[/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857148/179aa4bb86d739ff881298f911a6347e1bc993c0.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Exploration 🎃[/b][/h2][p]This update also expands the forest with new thing and areas to find, some are well hidden. [/p][p]There’s a new mysterious pumpkin patch in Pumpkin Valley with a new character, Scarecrow, who might have a riddle or two for you.[/p][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857148/2e2399d49b40bf83987b492bd61931069ee43b86.png"][/img][b]Pet Bumble Dog! 🐝[/b][/h2][p]We also have the most important addition. You can now pet Bumble Dog![/p][p]Bumble dog has also received a buff making him a bit stronger. In addition you now have the option to leave him at home if you prefer to play without him.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857148/47f884cb23e4f8b1ea6bad788693dbf101f01230.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]UI Rework📖[/b][/h2][p]The UI has also been reworked quite a lot. Both visually, with new backgrounds and animations, and in some cases the functionality has been remade too. [/p][p]The update brings more additions and changes (see Patch Notes below) but let's talk about the future!
[/p][h2]Future 🔮[/h2][p]Next up I’m focusing on combat. And there will be some big changes![/p][p]I’m aiming to release smaller updates, but more frequent ones. To help me focus on fewer features at a time and also faster implement players feedback and my own ideas. I think this will be beneficial to everyone!
If you want more frequent updates of the development and/or want to take part in giving feedback and help shape the game, please join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/UFa25FSt8z"]Discord server![/url] 💛[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the update![/p][h3]

Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p]New feature: Decoration[/p][list][*][p]Ability to place objects in the world[/p][/*][*][p]New interface[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Expanded hub world[/p][list][*][p]Hidden areas[/p][/*][*][p]Pumpkin patch[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]2 new unique battle areas[/p][/*][*][p]More interactable objects[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Character: Scarecrow[/p][list][*][p]Riddles[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bumble Dog improvements[/p][list][*][p]You can finally pet Bumble Dog![/p][/*][*][p]Option to leave Bumble Dog at home[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage and health[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Revamped spells[/p][list][*][p]New sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]New visuals[/p][/*][*][p]New functionality[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]UI Rework[/p][list][*][p]New pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Quest interface new visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Friends interface new visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Flower book functionality reworked[/p][/*][*][p]Flower book improved visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Placement functionality reworked[/p][/*][*][p]New decoration interface[/p][/*][*][p]Spell book interface functionality reworked[/p][/*][*][p]Spell book interface improved visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Recipe book updated[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]New feature: Battle Challenges[/p][list][*][p]Added to battle UI[/p][/*][*][p]1-3 challenges per battle[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Battle Changes[/p][list][*][p]Improved pathfinding[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to some battle layouts[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies made slower[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Visual Changes/Additions (too many and spread out to list)[/p][/*][*][p]Sound Changes/Additions[/p][list][*][p]Default music volume lowered[/p][/*][*][p]New dialogue sound effects [/p][/*][*][p]New placing/removing/moving sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]New quest sound effects [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ✨🌻New Update with New Content 🌻✨
notes.content:
A new update, v.0.1.3, is out now! And with it comes [b]brand new content![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857148/059c7729acb7dd14e70c19ef271f8533b8008e48.png[/img]

This is Honeymancers first update with brand new content!
[list]
[*] New Quests
[*] New Spells (Some are bee themed)
[*] New Flowers and Colors
[*] Another Bottle even!
[/list]

If you like Crow, Belle, Ace, Hank and/or Vlad you're in luck! The new quests will involve them. Some quests are combat focused, some are more personal and some are just about cool stuff. There's something for everyone!  💛 

This update, v.0.1.3, also gives you fixes to most reported bugs, new settings, environmental- and combat tweaks. See end of post for a list of additions and bug fixes.

Honeymancer now has a  Early Access Roadmap as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857148/4ef994780a487a942e7c76bb7447f4a8b7a0ac42.png[/img]

This is the first content from "Fixes, Feedback, Fun", more will come soon. After that we have the big contest patches and finally the full release. Lots to look forward to! 🍯✨

Thank you for the support 💛

Additions/Changes:
[list]
[*] 8 new quests
[*] 3 new spells
[*] 2 new flowers
[*] 3 new colors
[*] More stumps, branches and bushes around the forest
[*] Boomshrooms do more damage to enemies
[*] Friendship tab now shows who you've met
[*] It's now easier change tabs in the Pause Menu
[*] Ace moves to Woodhaven
[*] Secrets are more secret
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] The risk of losing control during dialogue options when using controller or keyboard is now fixed
[*] Weird colors behind trees removed
[*] Ants are now moving in the right direction
[*] More sounds are no longer using the incorrect sound mixer (some might still do, if you find one please let me know on Discord. Link below)
[*] The quests Get the Choppas and Forgetti are fixed
[*] Bottles can't be lost anymore
[*] No longer a risk of losing your seeds when exiting game
[/list]

If you want to help me fix more bugs or you want to give feedback to improve the game, please join me in Honeymancer's Discord server https://discord.com/invite/UFa25FSt8z

notes.title: 🐝 Mac Support Added! 🐝
notes.content:
It's been one week since release! And I'm super happy with how it's gone! 

I've released an update, v.0.1.2, which not only implements some of your feedback and fixes bugs you've reported, but I've also added Mac support so Apple users can now play Honeymancer as well! 

Thank you for the support 💛

Additions/Changes:
- Honey Jars now gives you 50% of your max Honey
- Health Potions now heals you 50% of your max Health
- A smooth zoom when starting and ending dialogues
- A toggle under Accessibility that lets you turn off the zoom in
- A setting under General for choosing if the aim arrow is permanently on or off, or if it's automatic
- Dizztroyers now have a red outline when spinning

Bug Fixes:
- No longer a chance to get stuck on the quest A Feast for Crow
- Seeds no longer have a risk of not being saved
- Teleporting to Pumpkin Valley will no longer cause wacky stuff
- Some sounds no longer use incorrect sound mixer (some might still do, please let me know on Discord. Link below)
- The quests [strike]Get the Choppas[/strike](New bug with this one. Sorry) and Forgetti should work correctly this time around
- Bottles no longer have a risk of not being saved

If you want to help me fix more bugs or you want to give feedback to improve the game, please join me in Honeymancer's Discord server https://discord.com/invite/UFa25FSt8z

notes.title: Thank you for playing! And bug fixes 🐝
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing the game! I am so happy that so many of you have played and enjoyed it 💛

It would be very helpful if you left a review of the game so that more people can find it and enjoy it. It helps small games and creators a whole lot 🐻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42857148/43a53b486e6dc08adebe4d325a5b5da1d6dc49b5.png[/img]
We made an update to the game last night, v.0.1.1. Where we fixed all the so far reported bugs and did some small addition that's been suggested. If you want to report bugs or suggest things to and or change I highly recommend that you join our Discord Server ( https://discord.com/invite/UFa25FSt8z ). It's easier and quicker for me to you respond there 🐝 

Bugs fixed:
- You can now press New Game on Steam Deck (you might have to restart your Steam Deck for this to work)
- Placing Mode HUD no longer showing when exiting with ESC
- The quest There's A Leek now works with correct expressions and reward
- During the quest Forgetti you no longer get stuck in Borts dialogue
- First level in Pumpkin Valley no longer gets stuck on wave 2
- Third level in Pumpkin Valley no longer auto completes
- Bottles are now saved when exiting the game
- You can no longer walk out into the void
- The quest A Feast For Crow can now be completed 

Additions:
- The game now tells you when it's saving (during loading screens and when exiting the game)
- You can now use Space Bar to go forward in dialogues. (B for xbox controllers and Circle for playstation controllers)
- A check in side your home that make sure you have gotten the correct reward from quest. If you have played and one of the bugged quest didn't give you a reward you will now have it when you start the game.

That's it for now!
Thanks again for playing and an extra thank you to those of you who reported bugs and left reviews! 💛

More updates are coming soon! 🍯✨
